description: The DANS Data Station release is the AgMIP wheat pilot benchmark used by the linked Open Data Journal for Agricultural Research article. It combines quality-checked field observations from Australia, the Netherlands, India and Argentina with local daily weather, soil properties, crop and soil nitrogen and water, growth and yield components. The deposit also reports outputs from 27 wheat models and sensitivity experiments involving carbon dioxide, temperature, heat at flowering and management choices. Its named public page and DataCite registry list CC0 1.0. A food-supply modeller can compare simulated wheat growth and yield with the field observations or reproduce parts of the model intercomparison. The four sites span contrasting environments but cannot establish performance across every wheat region. Model outputs must be kept separate from observed measurements when calibrating or testing a new model. Exact file-to-variable mapping and completeness were not checked because no package was downloaded. No directly related catalogue record was found in the full identity scan.
